b33_value.instructions: Look at the round prohibitory speed-limit sign (Polish sign B-33: a white disc with a red border and a black number) in this street-level photo crop. Which speed limit value in km/h does it show? Answer 'none' if the crop does not show such a sign, for example a speed-limit zone sign, the end of a zone or of a speed limit, another sign, or no sign at all. Answer 'unreadable' if such a sign is present but its number cannot be read.
